missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Дрова' is a plural-only noun in the nominative as the subject of 'лежат'. 'Сухие' is the agreeing plural adjective describing dry firewood.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дрова' is the accusative direct object of 'купили'; for this inanimate plural-only noun the accusative matches the nominative. 'На зиму' marks the purpose.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Дров' is the genitive plural after the negation 'нет'. The fleeting vowel appears in this irregular form, and 'в сарае' marks the location.
Strategic focus: Instrumental means. 'Дровами' is the instrumental plural naming what the stove is heated with. 'Хорошими' is the agreeing instrumental adjective.

missions.phrase: Дедушка пошёл за дровами в лес.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Дровами' is instrumental after 'за', expressing going to fetch firewood. A common purpose-of-motion pattern.

missions.phrase: Я положил несколько поленьев к дровам.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Дровам' is the dative plural after 'к', marking what the logs were added to. The irregular stem keeps the fleeting vowel out here.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Дровах' is the prepositional plural after 'на', marking where the cat sits. 'Большая' agrees with the feminine subject 'кошка'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Дрова' is the plural-only nominative subject of 'горят'. 'Эти' agrees in plural, and 'быстро' describes how fast it burns.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дрова' is the accusative object of the imperative 'принеси', identical to the nominative for this inanimate plural noun. 'Из сарая' marks the source.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Дров' is the genitive plural after 'без'. The irregular zero-ending form warns that without firewood they will freeze in winter.
